descs.compress: Shrink JPEG, PNG, WebP and AVIF images with real before and after sizes. Drop several files at once and compress the whole batch in one pass.
descs.compress-to-size: Hit a 10 KB, 20 KB, 50 KB, 100 KB, 200 KB, 500 KB, 1 MB or custom size by searching quality and, if allowed, dimensions.
descs.resize: Resize images by pixels or percentage with aspect-ratio lock, fit, fill or stretch modes, plus optional batch output for many files at once.
descs.crop: Crop any image with a percentage box, fixed aspect ratios, rounded corners or a true circular crop with transparent corners, then export as PNG or JPEG.
descs.application-photo: Prepare passport, visa, UPSC, SSC, NEET, JEE, GATE and signature images with configurable size presets and a target KB limit.
descs.social-resize: Crop and export images for YouTube thumbnails and banners, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X and other presets with exact pixel dimensions.
descs.dpi: Read the embedded DPI or PPI of PNG and JPEG files, inspect real pixel dimensions, and write a corrected DPI copy without resampling the image.
descs.convert: Convert between JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, BMP, TIFF, GIF and ICO, and rasterise SVG, with batch output and transparent handling.
descs.image-to-pdf: Combine JPEG, PNG, WebP or rasterised SVG images into a single PDF, with one page per image or each image fitted neatly to A4 or Letter.
descs.base64: Encode an image to Base64 or a full data URI for embedding in code, or decode Base64 back into a real, decodable image file you can download.
descs.transform: Rotate by 90-degree steps, flip horizontally or vertically, or straighten a tilted photo with automatic canvas expansion.
descs.adjust: Adjust brightness, contrast, saturation and hue, or apply grayscale, sepia and inversion, with an original/result comparison.
descs.blur-redact: Blur, pixelate or paint over a rectangular region to hide faces, numbers or private details. The image is never uploaded and nothing is stored.
descs.annotate: Add a caption, label, callout text or a solid caption bar to an image with real canvas rendering, configurable colour, size and placement.
descs.border-padding: Add a border, outer padding, rounded corners, a solid or gradient canvas and an optional drop shadow to frame any image cleanly.
descs.watermark: Add visible text watermarks with configurable placement, opacity, rotation, tiling across the image and colour, exported as a flattened image.
descs.meme: Turn any image into a classic top and bottom caption meme with outlined Impact-style text, local processing and an instant download with no upload.
descs.collage: Arrange several images into a clean grid collage with configurable columns, gap, background colour and output width, then download the result.
descs.splitter: Split an image or a scanned page into a rows by columns grid of equal tiles and download every tile together in a single ZIP archive.
descs.merge: Merge two or more images horizontally or vertically into one strip with an optional gap and background colour, useful for comparisons and receipts.
descs.compare: Compare two images visually and numerically with dimensions, exact SHA-256 hashes and a perceptual similarity score, all computed locally.
descs.product-shadow: Place a product cut-out on a clean background with padding, rounded corners and a soft realistic drop shadow for marketplace listings.
descs.scan-cleanup: Turn phone photos of documents into cleaner grayscale or binarised pages and correct a manually measured tilt before you export.
descs.metadata-viewer: Inspect EXIF, GPS, camera details, dimensions, transparency, colour profile presence and embedded DPI in JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP and TIFF files.
descs.strip-metadata: Remove EXIF, GPS, camera and embedded metadata by re-encoding the image, then verify the exported file no longer carries a JPEG EXIF block.
descs.image-hash: Generate an exact SHA-256 hash plus perceptual average and difference hashes for image identity, deduplication and similarity checks.
descs.duplicate-finder: Find byte-identical duplicates and visually similar photos using SHA-256 and perceptual hashing, entirely in the browser.
descs.palette: Extract a dominant colour palette with hex values, inspect RGB and luminance histograms, and sample exact colours from anywhere in an image.
descs.favicon: Generate 16, 32, 48, 96, 180, 192 and 512 px PNG icons, a multi-entry ICO and a web manifest snippet from one square image.
descs.og-image: Compose a 1200 by 630 social preview card from an image with a headline, subtitle, dark overlay and an accent bar for Open Graph sharing.
descs.qr-code: Generate a real QR code for text or a URL with size, quiet zone, foreground and background colours and error-correction level, as PNG or SVG.
descs.qr-decode: Decode a QR code from a screenshot or photo entirely in your browser, with no upload, and read the exact text or URL it contains.
descs.barcode: Generate CODE128, EAN-13, EAN-8, CODE39 or UPC-A barcodes as real PNG or SVG images with built-in checksum validation for each symbology.
descs.svg-optimizer: Remove scripts, event handlers and dangerous URLs, validate basic SVG structure, and minify the markup for safer, smaller embedding.
descs.placeholder: Generate clean SVG or PNG placeholder images with exact dimensions, custom background and text colours, and an optional centred label.
descs.srcset: Generate several resized WebP, JPEG or PNG widths plus a ready-to-paste srcset and sizes snippet for responsive, faster-loading pages.
descs.gif-studio: Build an animated GIF from a sequence of images, or extract every frame from an existing GIF, with frame delay and resize controls.
descs.sprite-sheet: Pack several images into an evenly spaced sprite sheet and get a generated CSS background-position snippet for each frame automatically.
descs.batch-rename: Rename a batch of images with a numbered pattern and optionally convert the format, then download every file together as a single ZIP.
descs.inspection: Check real file signatures, decodability, dimensions, transparency, orientation and compression advice, and get a plain-English failure diagnosis.
descs.recovery: Attempt a best-effort decode and re-encode of a damaged image, with an honest report and clear reasons when recovery is not possible.
descs.photo-signature: Combine an application photo and a signature into one canvas with a configurable layout, spacing and export dimensions for forms.
